label: I-Bartack
description: The I-bartack is a straight, vertical or horizontal bar of dense stitching — literally shaped like the letter I — applied at each end of a pocket opening to lock the jets or welt in place and prevent the opening from spreading. It is one of the oldest and most traditional bartack forms in tailoring, closely associated with English bespoke work, and its simplicity makes it nearly invisible at conversational distance while providing robust reinforcement at the most stressed points of the pocket construction.
